body:
I freeze, my heart pounding against my chest like a drumbeat I can't escape. The stamp on the slip is just an excuse for them to send me home again without answering my questions about this job they're not entirely sure they want anymore. 

My mind races with scenarios - being forced into another uncomfortable meeting where I'm asked yet another round of unanswerable yes/no questions, or worse, being pushed out in the cold as if I don't belong here at all. Every part of my body tenses up, ready for whatever comes next.
